scope.description: The operation, target and observation period actually investigated.

finding.description: The strongest supported finding, separate from unproven historical attribution.

evidenceId.description: Exact original run evidence ID without appended prose.

proposedRemedy.description: Smallest supported corrective proposal and preconditions, or why no repair is justified. Never describe it as executed.

verification.description: How an authorized later correction would be verified; do not require performing it during read-only diagnosis.
